Extract Mean-Variance and Dropout Metrics

Source: R/RcppExports.R
ExtractMetricsCpp.Rd

Derives summary metrics from assay values and the corresponding counts.

Usage

ExtractMetricsCpp(assay_data, counts, low_expressed_thresh = 0.2)

Arguments

assay_data

A beachmat-compatible matrix of assay values, genes in rows.

counts

A beachmat-compatible counts matrix with the same dimensions as assay_data.

low_expressed_thresh

numeric. Threshold for considering a gene lowly expressed. Default: 0.2.

Value

A list with variance_mean_cor and mean_dropout_residual (numeric scalars) and n_cells, n_genes (integer scalars).
